name: Superpowers (obra)
hook: Jesse Vincent's structured agentic-development methodology skill pack has hit 318k stars — the most-starred Claude Code plugin in the ecosystem. It orchestrates brainstorming → design review → implementation plan → subagent-driven development → TDD → code review → branch completion, with discrete SKILL.md files at each stage. Install is one command from the official marketplace.

name: Nuwa Skill (女娲.skill)
hook: 38.3k stars and updated today. alchaincyf's Nuwa extracts a cognitive-framework skill from any named thinker — Jobs, Munger, Feynman, Musk — giving your agent the mental models and decision heuristics of that person rather than just a persona prompt. Each generated skill includes a fidelity scorecard and documents its own limits; a companion darwin-skill auto-improves the output over time.

name: video-shotcraft
hook: 19.9k stars, updated Nov 15. This Claude Code + Codex skill turns a product URL into a fully editable cinematic promo video: the agent captures live screenshots, picks shots from a 150-entry motion-recipe library, storyboards the film, animates it in Remotion, syncs cuts to music, and exports MP4. Because frames are code-generated from your own screenshots, every frame is editable after export.

name: claude-code-best-practice (shanraisshan)
hook: 69.1k stars and updated today — "from vibe coding to agentic engineering." The repo maps every Claude Code concept (subagents, hooks, skills, MCP, sessions, context, CLI flags) to concrete best-practice notes, compares 6+ community frameworks (Superpowers, Spec Kit, BMAD-METHOD, OpenSpec…), and curates ~84 attributed tips from Boris Cherny, Thariq, and others. No install needed; it ships a live .claude/ folder with example commands, agents, and skills.

name: awesome-agent-skills (VoltAgent)

name: ARIS (Auto-Research-In-Sleep)
hook: 19.2k stars, updated Nov 14. Lightweight Markdown-only skills for autonomous ML research: idea discovery, experiment automation, paper review, rebuttal drafting, slide and poster creation. install: claude plugin marketplace add wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep && claude plugin install aris@aris

name: Darwin Skill (达尔文.skill)
hook: 6.9k stars, updated Nov 14. Autonomous skill-optimization loop for Claude Code inspired by Karpathy's autoresearch: Evaluate → Propose → Test (actually runs the skill) → Keep or Revert. Version 3.0 uses blind-judge model comparison rather than voting on SKILL.md text, eliminating self-serving bias. Pairs with nuwa-skill to form a full create-and-improve pipeline.

name: one-skill-to-rule-them-all (task-observer)
